testCases.title: Perception: Themes = Aucun thème → panel shows empty themes section
steps: Given I am on the Perception tab where no themes are detected in LLM results
When I find a row where the Themes column shows "Aucun thème" (no themes detected in any LLM)
Then the detail panel THEMES section shows "Aucun thème détecté dans les résultats des LLM" (empty)

testCases.title: Perception: panel shows SENTIMENT + RESPONSE sections, no rank badges
steps: Given I am on the Perception tab and I open a question in the detail panel
When the detail panel opens for a Perception question
Then SENTIMENT section and RESPONSE section are visible and no rank badges appear

testCases.title: Perception: switching LLM engine keeps SENTIMENT section with per-engine value
steps: Given a Perception question detail panel is open with multiple LLM engines available
When I switch to a second LLM engine in the panel
Then SENTIMENT section remains visible and a sentiment card is shown for the selected engine

testCases.title: Perception: Themes = theme badges → panel shows themes list
testCases.error: Toyota staging dataset has no Perception rows with themes extracted — all rows show "No theme extracted". Re-enable when a dashboard with Perception themes is available.
steps: Given I am on the Perception tab where one or more themes are detected in LLM results
When I find a row where the Themes column shows one or more theme badges
Then the detail panel THEMES section shows the list of detected themes
